statement: Things used every day are kept within 5 ft of where they are first used

acceptance.quantity: farthest daily thing from its place of use

rationale: 5 ft is two steps. The cook's triangle allows 9 ft for a walk made a few times a meal; a pan, a plate or a knife is fetched far more often. No guideline gives this number: it is this project's own

mechanism.how: For each kind used every day, the straight line from where a person stands at its cabinet to the centre front of the range, sink, dishwasher, refrigerator or prep sink it serves; the longest is reported
